title: Thai Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with chicken, noodles, and a blend of Thai spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, and noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the honey and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
